def VTask.subtypePreimage : {α : Sort u_1} -> {β : Sort u_4} -> (p : α → Prop) -> [DecidablePred p] -> (x₀ : { a // p a } → β) -> { x // x ∘ Subtype.val = x₀ } ≃ ({ a // ¬p a } → β) :=
  fun {α} {β} (p : α → Prop) [DecidablePred p] (x₀ : { a // p a } → β) =>
    {
      toFun : { x // x ∘ Subtype.val = x₀ } → ({a // ¬p a} → β)
      := fun ⟨x, hx⟩ => fun a ↦ x a.val
      invFun : ({a // ¬p a} → β) → { x // x ∘ Subtype.val = x₀ }
      := fun y ↦ ⟨fun a => if h : p a then x₀ ⟨a, h⟩ else y ⟨a, h⟩, by
        -- Prove that the constructed function extends `x₀`
        ext ⟨a, ha⟩
        simp [ha]
        <;> simp_all [Subtype.ext_iff]
        <;> aesop
      ⟩
      left_inv : ∀ (f : {x // x ∘ Subtype.val = x₀}), invFun (toFun f) = f
      := by
        intro ⟨x, hx⟩
        ext a
        have h₁ : (if h : p a then x₀ ⟨a, h⟩ else (fun a ↦ x a.val) ⟨a, by tauto⟩) = x a := by
          split_ifs with h
          · -- Case: p a is true
            have h₂ : x ⟨a, h⟩ = x₀ ⟨a, h⟩ := by
              have h₃ := congr_fun hx ⟨a, h⟩
              simp at h₃ ⊢
              <;> aesop
            simp_all [h₂]
          · -- Case: p a is false
            simp_all [Subtype.ext_iff]
            <;> aesop
        simp_all
        <;> aesop
      right_inv : ∀ (f : ({a // ¬p a} → β)), toFun (invFun f) = f
      := by
        intro y
        ext ⟨a, ha⟩
        simp [ha]
        <;> aesop
    }
